A patch for the vision pack download, plus a pile of small fixes and polish from the new look.

## New

- When nothing is using the camera and the window is minimised or in the tray, the effects stop until an app opens the camera or you open the window. Until then Telescope uses almost no processor. The stream from the phone stays up, so it picks back up at once.
- Room to move in Auto framing shows a bubble while you drag it, with a box for how far you can move before the framing follows.
- The restart bar in Settings > Plugins has a **Revert** button that puts the plugins you switched on or off back the way they were.
- A phone that gets too hot lowers the frame rate first and then the picture size. If it gets critical it pauses the camera until it cools down and keeps the stream and mic up.

## Fixed

- The vision pack download no longer fails on slower internet. It had a time limit on the whole download and gave up even while it was still downloading. The same went for adb, VB-Cable and update downloads.
- Installing the vision pack zip through **Install** in Settings > Plugins works now, instead of being turned away as a too big plugin. Picking the zip while the pack is still downloading or installing shows a warning that the file wasn't used instead of doing nothing.
- Telescope uses the graphics card your system picks for it instead of always going for the fastest one. A laptop set to its built-in graphics should stay on it now.
- Browser camera and webcams are remembered as the last pick again instead of going back to the first phone.
- The restart bar slides all the way out instead of shrinking into a line.
- Presets, Updates, Devices, Photos and Stream output have their icons back in Settings > Plugins.
- Turning on **Values** in the colour picker no longer moves the switch away from your cursor.
- The corners of the colour picker's square no longer let a bit of light through.
- Chroma key's Edges slider handle takes the colour under it like the others.
- The gaps around the card columns are the same width on every side.
- The window uses a bit less processor with a lot of cards open.

## Changed

- Cut-in in Background has its own icon.
